title: Do Coding Agents Understand Why Systems Crash---and Why They Don't?
abstract: arXiv:2610.29332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable of fixing real-world bugs, yet they still struggle with large systems codebases such as the Linux kernel. To understand why, we test how agents reason about execution in these codebases through crash reasoning: predicting from source code whether a given input crashes the system. A correct prediction alone, however, does not establish this ability, since it may come from merely spotting suspicious code. In this paper, we propose source interventions: we pair source trees that differ by a single commit, so that the same input crashes only one of them, and test whether agents predict crashes more often on the crashing tree. Experiments with four coding agents on SysRB, our dataset of 934 such pairs from Linux and OSS-Fuzz projects, yield three main findings. translated_title: 编码智能体理解系统为什么崩溃——以及为什么不崩溃吗？
translated_abstract: 编码智能体修复真实世界漏洞的能力日益增强，但它们在处理像Linux内核这样的大型系统代码库时仍然表现不佳。为了理解其中的原因，我们通过崩溃推理来测试智能体在这些代码库中的执行推理能力：即根据源代码预测给定输入是否会导致系统崩溃。然而，仅有正确的预测并不足以证明这种能力，因为预测可能仅仅来自于发现可疑代码。在本文中，我们提出了源代码干预方法：我们配对仅相差一次提交的源代码树，使得相同的输入只会使其中一棵代码树崩溃，并测试智能体是否更频繁地在崩溃的代码树上预测出崩溃。我们在SysRB——一个包含来自Linux和OSS-Fuzz项目的934对代码树的数据集——上对四个编码智能体进行了实验，得到了三个主要发现。首先，智能体倾向于预测不会崩溃：它们很少误报，但漏掉了许多真实的崩溃，即使是表现最好的智能体也漏掉了超过……
tldr: 本文提出“源代码干预”方法和包含934对代码树的SysRB数据集，通过配对仅相差一次提交的源代码树来严格测试编码智能体的崩溃推理能力，发现智能体严重倾向于预测“不崩溃”，从而漏掉了大量真实的系统崩溃。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "source interventions" and the SysRB dataset of 934 source-tree pairs differing by a single commit to rigorously test coding agents' crash reasoning, revealing that agents are strongly biased toward predicting no crash and miss many real system crashes.
